sideA.summary: DELIVERED: 551-700. Despite inexperience, they did the impossible, and the world paid for their leaders' fear, Utopia's malice, and the Hollow Men's savagery. This time they have a cure. The world should recover, with new cities and new countries. Rebuilding will take an unknown time, and they will be part of it. DELIVERED: 401-550. They did not want the front lines this soon. The world is in riot, anarchy, and near collapse. Without Utopia in the east, those cities rose. There is a cure, and it is not clear the world lasts long enough to use it. Some cities will make it, and they hope to rebuild from there.
sideA.text:
DELIVERED: 551-700
They did the impossible despite their inexperience. The world paid for their leaders' fear, Utopia's malice, and the Hollow Men's savagery, but there is a cure. They believe the world recovers, with new cities and new countries. Nobody knows how long rebuilding takes, and they will be part of it.

DELIVERED: 401-550
They did not want to be on the front lines so soon, and the world is a disaster: rioting, anarchy, near collapse. Without Utopia in the east, those cities have risen. There is a cure, and they are not sure the world survives long enough to use it. Some cities will make it, and they hope the world can rebuild from there.

sideB.summary: DELIVERED: 400 AND BELOW. A note left in hope that someone finds it. Mistrust between Faded and normal humans was too much, and they were overwhelmed. There is a cure, and it may be too little, too late. The effort was great and the burden too heavy. They tried. Found in the ruins of North Atlantic Haven.
